en: The postcard features two sides. The front displays an illustration of a group of people, men and women, dressed in traditional folk costumes, performing a dance in front of a large wooden rural building with a thatched roof. Surrounding the dancers are trees, and the background is pastoral. Handwritten text is present at the bottom. The reverse side is titled 'BREFKORT. CARTE POSTALE' and is addressed to 'Fröken Lydia Strandberg' at 'Fredsgatan, Sundsvall,' with a green 'SVERIGE' postage stamp and additional handwritten address details. Swedish text is prominent.
